_help: Voice command catalog for laya_server.py. Laya picks ONE action by its description (edit freely). 'strip' is a regex removed from the start of the transcript to get the action's argument {arg}. Below min_probability nothing runs (a 'didn't catch that' notification instead). Keep descriptions short: longer prompts (>128 tokens total) fall off the Neural Engine and roughly double latency. Action kinds: open_app, open_url, shell (argv list, {arg} substituted per-element, never through a shell), applescript (script gets {arg} as argv item 1), none.

open_app.description: open or switch to an app
strip: ^(open|launch|start|switch to|go to|bring up|pull up|show)( up)?( the| my)?( app| application)?\s+

web_search.description: search the web or look up a question
strip: ^(search( the web| google| online)?( for)?|google|look up|find( me)?( info on)?)\s+

new_reminder.description: add a reminder or to-do item
strip: ^((add|create|make|set|put)( a| me a)? (new )?reminders?( to| for)?|(new )?reminders?( to)?|remind me( to)?|(add|put))\s+
new_reminder.script:
on run argv
 tell application "Reminders" to make new reminder with properties {name:item 1 of argv}
 return "Reminder: " & item 1 of argv
end run

new_note.description: write down a note to keep
strip: ^((take|make|write|create)( a| down a)? (new )?note( that| saying| about)?|(new )?note( that)?|jot down|write down)\s+
new_note.script:
on run argv
 tell application "Notes" to make new note with properties {body:item 1 of argv}
 return "Note saved"
end run

play_pause.script:
on run argv
 tell application "Music" to playpause
 return "Play/pause"
end run

volume_up.script:
on run argv
 set v to output volume of (get volume settings)
 set volume output volume (v + 15)
 return "Volume up"
end run

volume_down.script:
on run argv
 set v to output volume of (get volume settings)
 set volume output volume (v - 15)
 return "Volume down"
end run
